question: _________ is the youngest Indian cricketer to play all three formats (test matches, one-day internationals and twenty-twenty internationals) of the game.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Ishant Sharma.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ishant Sharma** is an Indian cricketer who has represented India in **Tests, ODIs, and T20Is**. He is a **1.93 m tall right-arm fast-medium bowler**.
 
• In 2011, Sharma became the **5th youngest player to take 100 Test wickets.**
 
• Against South Africa in the year 2013,** Sharma again became the 5th quickest Indian to grab 100 One Day International wickets.**
 
• In the year** 2020, Ishant Sharma was awarded the prestigious Arjuna Award.**
 
• In the month of** February 2021, he became the second fast bowler from India to take 300 Test Wickets.**

• **Kuldeep Yadav** is a** left-arm wrist spin **bowler from India.
 
• **Rishabh Pant **is the **left-handed wicket-keeper batsman** of the Indian cricket team.
 
• **Hardik Pandya** is the r**ight-handed bowling allrounder** of the Indian Cricket Team.
 
• The Arjuna Award is the** second-highest sporting honour** of India (after **Major Dhyanchand Khel Ratna) **which was **first given in the year 1961.**
 
• The** prize money** for Arjuna Award is** Rs. 15 Lakhs.**
